blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is largely decided and the new prompt is most suppressed. Across settings ranging from a single switch to long multi-switch generation, RG substantially improves prompt switching capability on existing streaming models, including those with dedicated switching mechanisms, while largely retaining visual quality. As it requires no training or per-model tuning and adds only one forward pass per chunk, RG can be easily integrated into existing real-time video generation pipelines.
blocks.zh: 实时交互式视频生成可以让用户在生成过程中更改提示来引导正在演化的视频. 然而,现有的流出模式,即逐块生成视频,往往在切换后跟随上一个提示. 我们追踪到这种失败的来龙去脉,在这种情况下,先前的块是压制新快件的强大前奏。 此外,我们发现,即使缓存只保留了先前的块,但丢弃上下文会打破视觉连续性,从而限制了编辑缓存的方法,这种惯性仍然存在. 我们不编辑缓存,而是提出"残余指导"(RG),这是一种简单的,无训练的方法,用缓存外测得的校正来抵消上下文惯性. 具体地说,RG denoises在新快报下一次重新点名的上块,没有缓存,并在下块的早期去点名步骤上添加所形成的剩余部分,其内容基本确定,而新快报被最压制. 在从单一开关到长多开关生成等各种设置中,RG大幅度地提高了现有流线模型(包括具有专用开关机制的流线模型)的即时开关能力,同时在很大程度上保持了视觉质量. 由于RG不需要培训或按型号进行调试,每块只增加一个前行通道,因此RG可以很容易地被整合到现有的实时视频生成管道中.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Conventional video diffusion models [ 51 , 27 , 58 , 13 , 31 , 62 , 61 , 40 , 17 ] typically employ bidirectional attention, allowing video tokens to attend to both past and future frames.
Consequently, they generate a predefined sequence of frames jointly, with the prompt specified before generation and the video becoming available only after the entire sequence has been denoised.
This prevents users from interacting with the generation process as the video unfolds.
blocks.zh:
常规视频传播模式[51、27、58、13、31、62、61、40、17] 通常采用双向关注,允许视频符号同时关注过去和未来的框架。
因此,它们联合生成一个预先定义的帧序列,生成前指定的快取和视频只有在整个序列被去名后才能使用.
这使得用户无法随着视频的展开而与生成过程互动.

blocks.en:
Recent autoregressive video diffusion models instead adopt causal attention [ 6 ] , where each chunk attends to previous chunks through a KV cache [ 41 ] .
Combined with few-step distillation from a bidirectional teacher [ 60 , 19 , 56 , 63 , 9 , 34 , 26 ] , such models achieve real-time streaming generation, in which each chunk is displayed as soon as it is generated.
Since the video unfolds while it is being generated, users can change the prompt along the way to steer the evolving video [ 56 , 22 , 47 , 43 , 33 , 57 , 59 ] , for example, to introduce a new event, modify an existing scene, or control a simulated environment.
However, this interaction remains unreliable.
As shown in Fig. 1 and Fig. 2(a) , streaming models often fail to reflect prompt changes and continue to generate content consistent with the previous prompt.
Existing approaches modify the KV cache at prompt boundaries to improve responsiveness [ 56 , 59 ] , yet the problem persists.
blocks.zh:
最近的自旋相机视频传播模型转而采用因果注意[6],其中每个块通过KV缓存处理以前的块[41].
结合由双向教师分出几步蒸馏[60,19,56,63,9,34,26],这种模型实现了实时流出生成,每块一被生成就被显示.
由于视频在生成时会展开,用户可以沿途改变提示来引导不断发展的视频[56,22,47,43,33,57,59],例如引入新事件,修改已存在的场景,或者控制模拟环境.
然而,这种互动仍然不可靠。
如图1和图2(a)所示,流线模型往往不能反映即时变化,并继续生成与上一个即时相符合的内容.
现有方法在快速边界修改了KV缓存,以提高响应性[56,59],然而问题依然存在.

blocks.en:
To understand this failure, we analyze the model’s prediction of the switch chunk (Fig. 2(b) ) and find that the cached visual content acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt, a phenomenon we term context inertia .
Our analysis reveals two properties of context inertia.
First, the inertia comes from what the cached frames depict rather than from the prompt used to generate them, and persists even when only the previous chunk is cached.
This explains why cache-based approaches fall short, as re-caching [ 56 ] updates only the prompt information while keeping the cached frames, and flushing the cache [ 59 ] still retains the sink and the last frame.
Second, the suppression is most pronounced at the first denoising step, where the content of the chunk is largely determined.
Removing the context entirely would eliminate the inertia but would break subject identity and scene continuity (Fig. 2(c) ), suggesting that the cache should be kept and its pull countered in the prediction instead.
A natural way to do so is classifier-free guidance [ 18 ] , but its direction is computed under the same cache and is likewise suppressed (see Supp. F.2 ).
Together, these observations suggest that the prompt signal should be measured without the cache, where context inertia is absent, and applied where the inertia is strongest.

为了了解这一失败,我们分析了模型对开关块(图2(b))的预测,并发现缓存的视觉内容在压制新的快感(我们称之为上下文惯性)之前起到强大的作用。
我们的分析揭示了背景惯性的两个特性.
首先,惯性来自缓存相框所描绘的东西,而不是用于生成它们的快取,即使只有之前的块被缓存,惯性仍然持续存在.
这解释了基于缓存的方法之所以不足的原因,因为重取 [56] 仅更新了即时信息而保留了缓存框架,冲取缓存 [59] 仍然保留了汇和上帧.
第二,抑制措施在第一个取消提名的步骤中最为突出,该块的内容基本上由该步骤决定。
完全去除上下文将消除惯性,但将打破主题特性和场景连续性(图2(c)),建议保留缓存,取而代之的是,在预测中反之。
这样做的自然方式是无分级制导[18],但其方向在同一缓存下计算,同样被压制(见Supp.F.2.
这些观测结果共同表明,应当在没有缓存的情况下,在没有上下文惯性的情况下,对即时信号进行测量,并在惯性最强的地方应用.

blocks.en:
Based on this insight, we propose Residual Guidance (RG) , a simple, training-free method that strengthens the new prompt without cache modification.
Specifically, RG denoises a re-noised copy of the preceding chunk under the new prompt without the cache and adds its difference from the original chunk to the early denoising steps of the next chunk.
This residual captures how the previous content would be redrawn under the new prompt without context inertia, releasing the prediction from that content and supplying the suppressed prompt signal.
Because the correction acts on the prediction rather than on the cache, each chunk still attends to its full context, which preserves subject identity and scene continuity.
For the same reason, RG is orthogonal to how the cache is managed and can be combined with existing cache-based switching methods.
RG requires only one additional forward pass per chunk and uses a single configuration across models.
blocks.zh:
基于这一见解,我们提出"残留指导"(RG),这是一种简单,无训练的方法,可以加强新的快取而无需缓存修改.
具体地说,RG denoises在新快件下重新命名了上块的复制件,没有缓存,并将其与原块的相差加到下块的早期去命名步骤上.
这种剩余内容捕捉到如何在新的快件下重新绘制之前的内容而不出现上下文惯性,释放出该内容的预测,并提供了被压制的快件信号.
由于校正作用于预测而不是缓存,因此每个块仍然关注其全部上下文,这保留了主体身份和场景连续性.
出于同样的原因,RG对缓存的管理方式是正交的,可以与现有的以缓存为基础的切换方法结合.
RG每块只需要多一个前传,并使用一个跨模型的单一配置.

blocks.en:
We evaluate our approach on seven streaming baselines, including methods with dedicated switching mechanisms, across settings ranging from a single switch in a 5 s video to six prompts over 60 s.
RG improves average switch achievement from 21% to 58% on single-attribute switches, from 47% to 66% on three-event stories, and from 66% to 81% on long interactive generation, while largely preserving visual quality.
The improvements hold across all baselines and persist over successive switches.
In a user study, RG achieves an overall preference score of 70.7%.
RG reduces throughput by only 6% in the single-switch setting, making it practical for real-time generation.

RG提高了单属性开关的平均切换率从21%提高到了58%,从47%提高到了66%,从66%提高到了81%,同时在很大程度上保持了视觉质量。
改进涉及所有基线,并持续超过接连的开关。
在用户研究中,RG实现70.7%的总偏好分.
RG在单开关设置中仅将吞吐量减少6%,使得实时生成实用.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows:
(1) We characterize context inertia in streaming video generation, showing that cached visual content, rather than stale prompt information, suppresses new prompts, particularly at the first denoising step.
(2) We propose Residual Guidance , a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia in the prediction rather than in the cache, by measuring the effect of the new prompt without the cache and applying it where the inertia is strongest.
(3) We demonstrate its effectiveness on seven streaming baselines across diverse switching scenarios, with consistent gains in prompt-switch responsiveness at minimal cost in quality and speed.

(3) 我们通过不同切换情景的7个流线基线,在快速切换反应能力方面取得持续进展,质量和速度成本最低,从而证明它的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent streaming models distill bidirectional teachers into few-step causal students [ 60 , 19 , 56 , 63 , 9 , 34 , 26 ] that condition each chunk on previously generated content through a KV cache [ 41 ] .
To handle prompt switches, LongLive [ 56 ] attributes the failure to stale prompt information in the cache and re-encodes past frames under the new prompt, while Infinity-RoPE [ 59 ] keeps only a sink and the last frame and Anchor Forcing [ 57 ] rebuilds the cache from stored anchor states.
MemFlow [ 22 ] and SWIFT [ 47 ] instead manage the memory by retrieving prompt-relevant history and injecting transition-aware signals, respectively.
Despite their different memory strategies, these methods all retain previously generated visual content in the cache, which we find continues to suppress the new prompt (Sec. 3 ).
RG instead counteracts this suppression in the prediction rather than in the cache, which preserves continuity and keeps it compatible with these approaches.
blocks.zh:
最近的流派模式将双向教师分解成几个步骤的因果学生[60、19、56、63、9、34、26],通过一个KV缓存使每个学生对以前生成的内容进行分解[41]。
要处理即时开关,LongLive [56] 将无法在缓存中分解即时信息属性,并在新快件下重新编码过去帧,而Infinity-RoPE [59] 只保留了一槽并保留了最后一帧和Anchor Forcing [57] 从所存储锚地状态重建缓存.
MemFlow [22]和SWIFT [47] 取而代之的是管理内存,分别取回了即时相关的历史并注入了过渡意识信号.
尽管内存策略不同,这些方法都保留了缓存中以前产生的视觉内容,我们发现这些内容继续压制了新的快取(Sec. 3.
相反,RG在预测中而不是缓存中抵消了这种抑制,这保持了连续性并保持了与这些方法相容.

blocks.en:
Classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 18 ] strengthens conditioning by extrapolating the conditional prediction away from the unconditional one and is widely used in video diffusion models [ 51 , 58 , 13 ] .
Streaming students, however, are distilled at a fixed guidance scale [ 60 ] , and applying CFG on top of this distilled guidance only partially restores prompt responsiveness.
Its two branches are computed under the same cache, so the guidance direction is suppressed along with the prompt, and larger scales introduce artifacts (Supp. F.2 ).
History Guidance [ 45 ] combines predictions across history conditions, enabled by its frame-wise noise-level training, to improve temporal consistency rather than prompt responsiveness.
MAGI-1 [ 49 ] uses separate history and text guidance scales, but only its non-distilled model exposes an independently adjustable text guidance.
In contrast, RG measures a cache-free prediction with an already generated chunk, so its direction is not suppressed by the context, and it requires no unconditional branch.
A detailed comparison is provided in Supp. F.1 .
blocks.zh:
无分级制导(CFG) [18]通过将条件预测推出出无条件的分级来强化了调制,并被广泛用于视频传播模型[51,58,13].
然而,流生被分馏为固定制导尺度[60],在此分馏制导之上再应用CFG只能部分地恢复即时反应.
它的两个分会在同一缓存下被计算出,因此引导方向被与快取一起被压制,而更大的尺度引入了文物(Supp. F.2.
历史指导[45]结合了整个历史条件的预测,借助于其帧式噪声分级训练,可以提高时间一致性而不是迅速反应.
MAGI-1 [49] 使用单独的历史和文本指导尺度,但只有它的非蒸发模型暴露出一个可独立调整的文本指导.
相形之下,RG用已经生成的块来测量一个无缓存的预测,因此其方向不被上下文所压制,不需要无条件的分支.
补编提供了详细的比较。 F. 1 (英语).

blocks.en:
Many diffusion- and flow-based editing methods derive editing signals from source-target prediction differences. Delta Denoising Score [ 15 ] and Contrastive Denoising Score [ 38 ] use denoising prediction differences, while DreamMotion [ 21 ] uses score distillation with space-time self-similarity constraints. Delta Rectified Flow Sampling [ 4 ] extends delta-based guidance to velocity fields. FlowEdit [ 28 ] transports between source and target distributions, and FlowDirector [ 29 ] uses ODE-based flow corrections. ProxEdit [ 14 ] regularizes source-target differences, while TurboEdit [ 10 ] and ChordEdit [ 35 ] enable few-step and one-step image editing, respectively. StreamEdit [ 23 ] also builds on few-step streaming video generators without training, but edits a source video by conditioning a dual-branch sampler on it, whereas RG has no source video and counteracts the cached context of the ongoing generation.
SDEdit [ 36 ] simply re-noises an input and reconstructs it for image editing.
RG also re-noises the preceding chunk, but applies the difference between its cache-free reconstruction and the original chunk to the next chunk, without requiring the previous prompt or inversion.

Delta校正流采样 [4] 将基于三角地的取向延伸至速度场. 流动 编辑 [28] 介于源与目标分布之间的传输,Flow Director [29] 使用基于ODE的流量校正. ProxEdit [14] 将源目标差异正规化,而TurboEdit [10] 和 CordEdit [35] 则可以分别进行几步和一步图像编辑. StreamEdit [23] 也以几步串流的视频生成器为基础而未经过训练,但通过在它上配置一双分支采样器来编辑源视频,而RG则没有源视频并抵消了正在生成的缓存上下文.

blocks.en: 3.1 Prompt Switches Are Rarely Reflected
blocks.zh: 3.1 极小反射的快速开关

blocks.en:
We analyze Self Forcing [ 19 ] , a representative causal streaming student whose rolling KV cache is retained across the switch, and LongLive [ 56 ] , an interactive model that recomputes cached states under the new prompt at prompt boundaries.
We build a development set of 100 switch pairs ( y old , y new ) (y_{\text{old}},y_{\text{new}}) with an LLM [ 39 ] , covering diverse changes (e.g., color and motion), where y old y_{\text{old}} and y new y_{\text{new}} describe the states before and after the change.
For each pair, we generate a 10 s video of 14 chunks with the switch at 5 s, leaving 7 chunks to reflect the new prompt.
A VLM [ 1 ] then judges whether each post-switch chunk reflects y new y_{\text{new}} .
We categorize a switch as immediate if y new y_{\text{new}} appears within the first 2 chunks after the switch (about 1.5 s, allowing one chunk for a smooth transition), delayed if it appears in a later chunk, and never if it does not appear within the video.
As shown in Fig. 2(a) , only 16% and 25% of switches are immediate for Self Forcing and LongLive, respectively, while 80% and 64% are never realized.
Supp. A.1 details the prompt construction and VLM evaluation, and Supp. A.2 reports the results by type of prompt change.

We examine how the cached context affects the response to the new prompt, both quantitatively and qualitatively.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
Sec. 3 suggests that following the new prompt requires evaluating it without the cache, whereas preserving visual continuity requires generating with it. Residual Guidance (RG) satisfies both by measuring the prompt signal without the cache while generating the chunk with it.
Specifically, RG reconstructs a re-noised copy of the preceding chunk under the new prompt without the cache, and adds its residual from the original chunk to the cache-conditioned prediction of the next chunk at the early denoising steps, where context inertia is strongest.

具体地说,RG在新快件下重建了重新命名的上块副本而无缓存,并将其从原块的剩余部分添加到早期去诺步骤下对下块的缓存有条件的预测中,其中上下文惯性最强.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
We apply RG to Self Forcing [ 19 ] , Causal Forcing [ 63 ] , and MemFlow [ 22 ] , which retain the cache at switches, to LongLive [ 56 ] and Infinity-RoPE [ 59 ] , which modify the cache, and to Anchor Forcing [ 57 ] and SWIFT [ 47 ] , which use dedicated switch mechanisms.
Since RG leaves the cache untouched, it plugs into all seven baselines regardless of how they manage the cache, without retraining or per-model tuning, using the same configuration throughout.
All are distilled from Wan2.1-1.3B [ 51 ] , generate 832 × 480 832\times 480 videos, and use their native sampling.
Each model and its RG variant share the same seed, ensuring identical pre-switch frames.
We further apply our method to Rolling Forcing [ 34 ] in Supp. E.2 .

由于RG使缓存未受影响,它插入了所有7个基线,不管它们如何管理缓存,没有再培训或每个模型调取,全程使用相同的配置.
都从Wan2.1-1.3B[51]中分馏出,生成出832×480个832\时的480个视频,并使用其本土采样.
每个型号及其RG变体共享相同的种子,确保了相同的前开关帧.
我们进一步运用我们的方法,在《补编第34号》(E.2. )中将 " 推进 " 应用。

blocks.en:
We evaluate RG in three settings of increasing duration and number of switches, each probing a different aspect of prompt switching.
First, the 200 dynamic attribute prompts of T2V-CompBench [ 46 ] are split into initial and final states and generated as 5 s videos with the switch at 2 s.
Since only one attribute of the same subject changes, this setting most directly tests context inertia.
Second, 100 three-event stories from StoryEval [ 53 ] are generated as 10 s videos, with their events used as consecutive prompts and switches at 3 s and 7 s, testing whether a model can switch repeatedly.
Third, following MemFlow [ 22 ] and other interactive methods [ 56 , 57 , 47 ] , we use 100 scripts of six prompts, each active for 10 s over a 60 s video, which we refer to as InteractiveBench.
Prompt construction is detailed in Supp. C.1 .
Supp. E.1 , E.3 , and F.4 further cover action-binding prompts, where a new subject appears at the switch, InteractiveBench extended to 240 s, and explicit scene cuts with Infinity-RoPE [ 59 ] and its RoPE Cut.

blocks.en:
A VLM judge [ 1 ] determines whether the post-switch video depicts the new prompt (reliability in Supp. C.3 ). Achievement is the fraction of switches after which the video depicts the new prompt.
We exclude new prompts that the model cannot render even as an initial prompt, so that failures reflect the switch rather than the prompt.
On the post-switch segment, we report CLIP similarity [ 42 ] to the new prompt and the VBench [ 20 ] quality score, which aggregates seven quality dimensions with the official normalization and weights.
We also report VBench dynamic degree, which ensures that consistency is not obtained simply by producing static videos.
Following the VBench total score, Overall is computed as ( 4 ⋅ Quality + Achievement ) / 5 (4\cdot\text{Quality}+\text{Achievement})/5 , with Achievement in place of the semantic score.
For dynamic attributes, we additionally report the official T2V-CompBench score [ 46 ] .
Metric definitions are detailed in Supp. C.2 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 shows that context inertia severely limits existing models, especially when only a single attribute is requested to change.
Without RG, Achievement is at most 0.21 on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, MemFlow, and Infinity-RoPE, and 0.25 to 0.33 on LongLive, Anchor Forcing, and SWIFT.
RG raises Achievement by 0.28 to 0.46 on every base model, for example from 0.106 to 0.568 on Self Forcing.
These gains are not specific to the VLM judge, as CLIP and the official T2V-CompBench score, which evaluates both states of the prompt, improve on every base model as well.
The highest scores are obtained when RG is applied on top of LongLive, Anchor Forcing, and SWIFT, indicating that RG complements existing switching mechanisms rather than replacing them.
This improvement comes at little cost, as Quality stays within 0.01 of the base model.
Its slight decrease on most models reflects the known trade-off between consistency metrics and dynamic degree [ 20 ] , which rises on all models as the attribute change itself introduces motion (further discussed in Supp. D.1 ).
Overall therefore improves on every base model, with the two best scores on SWIFT and Anchor Forcing with RG.
Fig. 4 shows that, with RG, the requested attribute appears promptly after the switch (e.g., the bud blooms, a human face turns into a chimpanzee) while the subject and layout are largely retained (see Supp. D.2 ), whereas the base models mostly remain in the initial state.

To assess how users perceive these gains, 20 raters compare each base model with and without RG on the same prompt pairs (Fig. 3 ).
Averaged over base models, RG is preferred for following the new prompt in 73.1% of comparisons, while consistency remains slightly below parity at 44.3%.
Asked which result they would prefer when switching prompts in real time, raters choose RG 70.7% of the time, indicating that the gain in responsiveness outweighs the small loss in consistency in practical use (Supp. C.4 ).

blocks.zh: 5.3 损坏和替代品

blocks.en:
Fig. 6 visualizes the two main design choices.
The noise level τ \tau controls how much of the preceding chunk the reconstruction retains, acting as a strength knob analogous to the guidance scale: at τ = 700 \tau=700 , the sign remains yellow, at τ = 1000 \tau=1000 , it is redrawn with a new shape as in the context-free prediction (Fig. 2(c) ), and at τ = 850 \tau=850 , its color changes while its shape is preserved.
The step schedule balances the correction against refinement.
Adding the residual only at step 1 yields a partial switch, as the next step pulls the chunk back toward the cached context.
Adding it in full at step 2 as well, λ = ( 1 , 1 , 0 , 0 ) \lambda=(1,1,0,0) , counteracts this pull but overrides the shape inherited from the context, and extending it to step 3 produces artifacts.
Halving the weight at step 2, λ = ( 1 , 0.5 , 0 , 0 ) \lambda=(1,0.5,0,0) , prevents the pull-back while letting the cache restore the shape, leaving the later steps for refinement.
Quantitative results are provided in Supp. D.6 .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we trace the failure of prompt switching in streaming video generation to context inertia : cached visual content suppresses the influence of a new prompt, and existing cache-based switching strategies do not fully remove this suppression. Residual Guidance (RG) addresses the problem by measuring the effect of the new prompt without the cache and adding the resulting residual to the next chunk at its early denoising steps, where context inertia is strongest.
RG needs no training, combines with existing switching methods, and adds only one forward pass per chunk, making it practical for real-time use.
Across seven streaming baselines and settings ranging from a single switch to multiple switches in long video generation, RG substantially improves switch achievement while retaining visual continuity.
Nevertheless, some changes remain difficult, such as removing an object, and fine details can be altered along with the requested change.
We discuss these failure cases in Supp. F.5 as directions for future work.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们追踪到流出视频生成中即时切换失败到上下文惯性 :缓存的视觉内容会抑制出新的快感的影响,而以缓存为基础的现有切换策略并不能完全去除这种抑制. 残余指导(RG)通过测量没有缓存的新快件的效果来解决这个问题,并在其早期的去诺步骤(上下文惯性最强)中将由此产生的剩余部分添加到下块.
RG不需要训练,结合了现有的切换方法,每块只增加一个前行传出,使其适合实时使用.
在整个7个流线基线和设置中,从一个开关到长视频生成的多开关,RG在保持视觉连续性的同时大幅度地改进了开关的实现.
尽管如此,一些修改仍然很困难,如去除一个对象,细细的细节可以随所请求的修改而被更改.
我们在《补编第5号》中讨论这些失败案例,作为今后工作的方向。

The 100 switch pairs used in Sec. 3 were generated with GPT-5.5 [ 39 ] and cover eight categories of change: human motion, animal motion, object motion, physical state, color, scene, facial expression and lighting.
Each pair consists of a prompt y old y_{\text{old}} that describes the state before the change and a prompt y new y_{\text{new}} that describes the state after it, with the subject and the setting held fixed so that only the changed attribute differs between the two.
Every prompt ends with the suffix “Realistic video, natural lighting, static camera.”, which is omitted in Tab. 4 .

Sec. 3.2 measures how far the context moves the step-1 prediction.
Here we ask whether this translates into the generated video, and whether it depends on the kind of change.
We use the 100 pairs of the context inertia set, which span eight categories of change, and regenerate only the switch chunk with part of the cache hidden at every denoising step: no context, the previous chunk only, or, for LongLive, the sink only.
Everything else is unchanged, and a pair counts as switched if any two-chunk window after the switch is judged to show the new prompt.

我们使用上下文惯性集的100对,它跨越了8个类别的变化,并且只重新生成包含隐藏在每个去诺步骤上的部分缓存的开关块:没有上下文,只有上下文块,或者,对LongLive来说,只有槽.

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 shows that without intervention only 20% of the pairs switch on Self Forcing and 36% on LongLive.
Hiding the entire context raises these rates to 75% and 78%, whereas retaining only the previous chunk (30% and 41%) or only the sink (45% on LongLive) recovers little.
The largest gains occur for human motion, scene and color changes, where the new prompt modifies one property of an otherwise identical scene.
By contrast, expression changes are often realized even with the full context, while lighting changes show no improvement from context removal, suggesting a limitation of the capability of base models rather than context inertia.

In addition, a single reconstruction from a high noise level does not invert the noising, so it departs from s k − 1 s_{k-1} even for a typical sample.

The noise level τ \tau balances preserving the preceding chunk as an anchor against allowing the new prompt to modify its content: too little noise limits the possible displacement, whereas too much noise can discard details needed to preserve the ongoing scene.
We select τ = 850 \tau=850 based on the ablation in Sec. 5.3 .
Third, transferring the residual from the preceding chunk to the next relies on their local visual correspondence, as motivated by context inertia, rather than an exact equivalence between their predictions.
The score-difference interpretation in Eq. ( 9 ) applies directly to the switch chunk k k , whose preceding chunk was generated under y old y_{\text{old}} .

Their residuals therefore no longer represent an old-versus-new prompt contrast.
Instead, they provide local prompt-directed displacements anchored to the latest generated content, sustaining guidance as the cache incorporates chunks generated under the new prompt.

Alg. 1 gives the procedure following a prompt switch at chunk k k , which continues until the next prompt switch.
A single noise sample ϵ \epsilon is drawn at the switch and shared across all residuals during the prompt interval (line 1).
For each chunk j ≥ k j\geq k , the preceding chunk s j − 1 s_{j-1} is re-noised to level τ \tau and reconstructed in one cache-free forward pass under the active prompt.
The residual r j r_{j} is the displacement of this reconstruction from s j − 1 s_{j-1} (lines 4–5).
The chunk is then denoised using the original sampler, with λ i ​ r j \lambda_{i}r_{j} added to the clean prediction at each step (line 8).
With λ = ( 1 , 0.5 , 0 , 0 ) \lambda=(1,0.5,0,0) , the residual is injected only at the first two of the four denoising steps.
The resulting clean chunk s j s_{j} is appended to the cache as usual (line 14).

blocks.en: C.1 Benchmarks and Prompt Construction
blocks.zh: C.1 基准和迅速建造

blocks.en:
The prompts of T2V-CompBench dynamic attribute [ 46 ] describe a change of attribute in a single sentence, for example “A timelapse of a leaf transitioning from green to bright red as autumn progresses”.
Therefore, we split each prompt into one for the initial state and one for the final state, with the subject and the setting kept fixed, for example y old y_{\text{old}} “A green leaf on a tree branch” and y new y_{\text{new}} “A bright red leaf on a tree branch”.
A shared description of motion, lighting and camera is then appended to both prompts (e.g., “…, swaying gently in the breeze, soft natural light, slow camera push-in”).
This description serves two purposes.
First, a bare description of a state tends to yield a nearly static video, whereas the appended description gives the scene ongoing motion that must continue across the switch, as in interactive use.
Second, the streaming models are trained on long, detailed prompts, and the appended description keeps the inputs close to this distribution.
Since the description is identical in y old y_{\text{old}} and y new y_{\text{new}} , the two prompts differ only in the changed state, so any difference after the switch can be attributed to it.
The split was performed with an LLM and checked manually by the authors.
StoryEval [ 53 ] contains prompts with two to four events.
Since a two-event prompt is a single switch, which the dynamic attribute setting already covers, we randomly sample 100 three-event prompts.
InteractiveBench [ 56 ] is used as released by MemFlow [ 22 ] , with each of the six prompts active for 10 s.

因此,我们把每个提示分为一个初始状态和一个最终状态,主题和设置保持不变,例如y old y _{\text{old}}} “树枝上的绿叶”和 Y 新的 Y 文本{ new} “树枝上一朵明亮的红叶”。
对运动、照明和相机的共享描述随后被附在两个提示上(例如“......在微风中轻轻地摇动,柔软地自然光,慢相机推入”)。
这一描述有两个目的。
首先,一个状态的赤裸的描述往往产生一个近乎静态的视频,而后附的描述则给场景持续运动,必须像交互式使用一样在开关上继续.
其次,流线模型在长而详细的提示上被训练出,而后附的描述使得输入量接近于这种分布.
由于在 y 旧 y_{\text{old}}}和 y new_{\text{ new}}}中描述完全相同,两个提示只在已改变的状态中不同,所以切换后的任何区别都可以归结于它.
拆分用LLM进行,并由提交人手动检查。

blocks.en: All three settings share the same metrics. For each switch we call the chunks generated under the new prompt the post-switch segment, and quality metrics that measure consistency across frames exclude the switch chunk from it, so that the change requested by the prompt is not penalized as an inconsistency.

blocks.en: C.3 Reliability of the VLM Judge
blocks.zh: C.3 核查团法官的可靠性

blocks.en:
Achievement in all tables is determined by Qwen3-VL-8B [ 1 ] .
To assess whether our results are sensitive to this choice of judge, we repeat the evaluation with Qwen3-VL-32B, a larger variant of the same model, and InternVL3.5-38B [ 52 ] .
We randomly sample 100 prompt pairs from the dynamic attribute setting, distributed across the seven base models, and evaluate both the baseline and residual-guided videos for each pair, yielding 200 videos in total.
The three judges achieve pairwise agreement rates of 91 to 93%, with Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 8 ] ranging from 0.81 to 0.86 across judge pairs.
blocks.zh:
所有表格的成就由Qune3-VL-8B[1]决定。
为了评估我们的结果是否对法官的这一选择敏感,我们用同一种模型的较大变体Quen3-VL-32B和InternVL3.5-38B[52]重复评价.
我们从动态属性设定中随机抽取出100对即时对子,分布在7个基本模型中,并评价每对的基线和剩余制导视频,总共产生200个视频.
三位法官达成91%至93%的对等协议,而科恩的"克帕克"[8]从0.81到0.86不等。

blocks.en:
We further compare the three judges against human annotations on the same 200 videos.
To avoid bias, the videos are presented in random order without revealing the base model or whether residual guidance was used.
The annotator views each video in full, whereas the VLM judges evaluate the post-switch segment using a sliding window of two chunks.
The 8B, 32B, and InternVL judges achieve 84%, 85%, and 85% agreement with the human labels, respectively, with Cohen’s κ \kappa values of 0.67, 0.68, and 0.70.
These results show that all three judges are similarly aligned with human judgments, confirming that the 8B judge used in the main tables is not an outlier.

我们进一步比较这三名法官与同一200个视频上的人类说明。
为避免偏差,视频按随机顺序显示,而不披露底模,也不披露是否使用了剩余制导.

8B,32B,和InternVL的评委分别实现了84%,85%和85%与人类标签的一致,科恩的克帕克值分别为0.67,0.68和0.70.
这些结果显示,所有三名法官都与人类判决相似,证实主要表格中使用的8B法官并非外出法官。

blocks.en:

CLIP, which does not involve a VLM, and the official dynamic attribute score of T2V-CompBench, which uses a different model (LLaVA-1.6-34B [ 32 ] ) and evaluation protocol, both improve for every base model in Tab. 1 , consistent with Achievement.

blocks.en: C.4 User Study Details
blocks.zh: C.4 用户研究详情

blocks.en:
The study uses the dynamic attribute setting of Tab. 1 with its seven base models.
Each item compares a base model and the same model with residual guidance on the same prompt pair and seed, so that the two videos are identical before the switch.
We randomly select 15 pairs per base model (105 in total).

Each item is a single image with two rows, one per video, labeled Top and Bottom.

For each item, raters answer three questions.
Q1 asks, for each video separately, whether they noticed any unwanted change after the marker apart from the change the prompt asks for, such as in the background or other objects (No or Yes).

The user study does not involve any sensitive personal information or foreseeable risks to participants.

blocks.en:
RG changes VBench Quality by at most 0.008, with a small decrease on six of the seven models (Tab. 1 ).
Tab. 5 breaks this score into its seven dimensions.
RG lowers the three consistency dimensions (subject consistency, background consistency and temporal flickering) by up to 0.03 on every model and raises dynamic degree, whereas aesthetic quality, imaging quality and motion smoothness stay within about 0.01 of the base model.
The two movements have the same cause.
The base model keeps the initial state after the switch and is therefore nearly static, which yields high consistency for free [ 20 ] , while RG realizes the change and the frames across it differ.
The scene outside the changed object remains substantially closer to the pre-switch frame than in the no-context setting (Unint. in Tab. 3 ), although some scene drift remains (Supp. D.2 ).
Thus, the drop in consistency is partly associated with the requested change, but does not rule out unintended changes to the surrounding scene.

blocks.en:
To examine individual cases, we inspect the prompt pairs on which Quality drops the most.
Fig. 9 shows three of them, together with the VBench dimensions that change the most in either direction.
The ice cube example (middle) mirrors the average trend.
When the ice cube melts into a puddle of water, subject consistency falls from 0.999 to 0.901 and temporal flickering from 0.999 to 0.960.
The other two examples involve the aesthetic and imaging scores, which are unchanged on average but depend on the content that is shown.
When a 3D pixel art flower turns into a plain white square as requested, aesthetic quality falls from 0.655 to 0.293 and imaging quality from 74.1 to 44.8.
When bare soil turns into a garden in full bloom, imaging quality falls from 66.3 to 56.0 while aesthetic quality rises from 0.595 to 0.711.
These scores thus follow the requested content in either direction, consistent with their negligible change on average.
In all three cases, the base model keeps its high scores only because the video does not change.
The decrease in Quality is therefore largely a consequence of the requested change, and Quality should be read together with Achievement, which is the reason Overall combines the two.

Emptying the cache at the switch, as in the no-context condition of Sec. 3 , follows the new prompt but produces a chunk that is detached from the preceding frames, with the balloon and the leaf redrawn in a different scene.

blocks.en:
To quantify this, we measure how far the post-switch frames move from the last pre-switch frame, using a structure distance [ 50 ] (DINO self-similarity) and a perceptual distance (DreamSim [ 12 ] ) computed with the changed object masked out (Tab. 6 ).
The mask is obtained by detecting the changing object with OWLv2 [ 37 ] , using the two attribute states of the prompt as text queries, segmenting the detected box with SAM [ 25 ] .
RG moves the scene further than the base model on every model.
This is expected, since the base model often does not switch at all and the structure distance also includes the requested change.
The change nevertheless remains bounded.
The mean structure distance with RG is between 0.033 and 0.059, at or below a 1.2 × 1.2\times zoom of the same frame (0.047) on six of the seven models and far below that of another video (0.133).
The background distance is between a 1.2 × 1.2\times zoom and a 20% shift (0.037 and 0.058) on LongLive, MemFlow and SWIFT, and up to about twice the shift on the other models, an order of magnitude below another video (0.782).
The switch itself introduces no abrupt break, as the structure distance at the switch chunk stays below the zoom reference on every model.
In contrast, emptying the cache changes the background substantially more than RG, with an object-masked DreamSim distance of 0.191 and 0.163 on Self Forcing and LongLive against 0.089 and 0.046 for RG (Tab. 3 ).

blocks.en:
On T2V-CompBench dynamic attribute (Fig. 11 ), the base models keep the initial state after the switch, whereas RG realizes changes of shape (the cuboid unfolds into a figure, the ice cube melts into a puddle), state (the ice cream drips, the bread grows mold) and color (the ink turns green) within the first chunks, with the object, its position and the background preserved.

Causal Forcing上的薄月亮显示,变化是逐渐从几个块上而不是一次地到达的。

blocks.en:
On StoryEval (Fig. 12 ), the base models tend to continue the first event with small variations, as with the bear that never leaves the basket or the pharmacist who keeps counting pills.
RG follows each event as it is prompted, so the joey hops out and runs, the pharmacist fills and labels the bottle, and the penguin slides and dives.
Also for SWIFT, the spilled water from the glass forms into a river with RG where the glass remains for the base model.
blocks.zh:
在StoryEval(图12)上,基模倾向于以小的变数来延续第一个事件,如熊从不离开篮子或者药剂师不停地数起药丸.
RG跟随每个事件随其被激发,于是Joey跳出并跑出,药师将瓶子填上并贴上标签,企鹅滑出并下潜.
同样对于SWIFT来说,从玻璃上溢出的水会流入一条有RG的河中,其中的玻璃会留作基型.

blocks.en:
On InteractiveBench (Fig. 13 ), the base models reach some of the six prompts but miss others, for example SWIFT never shows the singer beside the guitarist and the crowd appears only at the end.
With RG each new subject enters when prompted and the scene develops in step with the script, including the new subject interacting with the existing one (the baker handing the croissant, the mother hugging the boy) while the setting stays continuous across all five switches.

blocks.en:
Tab. 7 reports the VBench-Long dimensions on InteractiveBench, computed on the whole 60 s video.
The values therefore differ from the Quality in Tab. 2 , which is computed on the post-switch segments (Supp. C.2 ).
The pattern is the same across all five base models and mirrors the 5 s results.
Subject and background consistency decrease by 0.005 to 0.009 with residual guidance, which is expected since each of the five prompt switches is now realized rather than ignored, and a video that changes its content cannot score as high on frame-level consistency as one that does not.
Imaging quality is unchanged within 0.006 in either direction, and temporal flickering, motion smoothness and aesthetic quality change by less than 0.005 on every model, so the guidance introduces no visible degradation.
Dynamic degree rises substantially, from 0.27 to 0.34 on MemFlow and from 0.37 to 0.51 on Infinity-RoPE for example, which reflects that the motion follows the changing prompts instead of settling into a static scene.
Under the official weighting, the aggregated quality score is unchanged or slightly higher with residual guidance on every base model except Anchor Forcing, where it is lower by 0.001.
Under both protocols, Quality stays within 0.006 of the base model.

blocks.en: D.5 Real-Time Practicality
blocks.zh: D.5 实时实用性

blocks.en: Table 8 : Throughput and responsiveness. Measured at batch size 1 with 5 s videos and one switch. RG adds one forward pass per chunk, reducing throughput by around 6%.
blocks.zh: 表8:产出和反应能力。 以分批尺寸1测量,有5 s 视频和1个开关. RG每块会增加一个前传,将吞吐量减少约6%.

blocks.en:
Tab. 8 shows that RG makes switches take effect faster at a small cost.
RG adds one forward pass per chunk, which lowers end-to-end FPS by about 6% for a 5 s video with one switch on both an RTX A6000 and an H100.
The FPS in Tab. 8 is measured over the whole 5 s video, which includes VAE decoding and the three pre-switch chunks generated without RG.
In long sessions where RG is active on every chunk, the cost is bounded by the per-chunk overhead.
Measured on the post-switch chunks alone, the chunks generated with RG run at 21.7 and 18.2 FPS on Self Forcing and LongLive on the H100, which is 13% and 16% below the base models and still above the 16 FPS playback rate, and peak memory is unchanged.
We measure responsiveness by the fraction of switches realized within two chunks ( Switched ≤ \leq 2 chunks ), the increase in CLIP similarity to the new prompt relative to the old one after the switch ( Δ \Delta CLIP), and the time at which this increase reaches half of its final value ( Onset ).
RG more than doubles both the switched fraction and Δ \Delta CLIP on both models and brings the median onset below 0.2 s.
Without RG, the onset stays at 0.62 s even on LongLive, whose cache adaptation at a switch does not remove context inertia.
blocks.zh:
标签8显示,RG使开关的起效更快,成本很小.
RG每块会增加一通前传,每5 s 的视频会将一通后传FPS降低约6%,其中一台开关同时是RTX A6000和H100.
(原始内容存档于2017-10-21). The FPS in Tab. 8被测量到整个5 s的视频上,这包括了VAE解码和在没有RG的情况下产生的3个前开关块.

Importantly, τ \tau is better viewed as a user-controllable knob than as a parameter that requires per-configuration tuning for RG to work.
Similar to the guidance scale in classifier-free guidance, it controls the trade-off between responsiveness to the new prompt and preservation of the current scene.
Indeed, every value in our sweep improves achievement over the base model.
For simplicity and consistency, we use the same τ = 850 \tau=850 across all models and benchmarks, without per-configuration tuning.
Users can adjust it to favor either responsiveness or preservation, and the preferred balance may vary across models and prompt types.

blocks.en:
Applying guidance only at the first step yields partial improvements in Achievement (0.47 and 0.63).
Extending full-strength guidance to the second step further improves responsiveness, but slightly compromises subject consistency.
Applying it through the third step provides only modest additional gains while substantially degrading both quality and subject consistency.
Our default schedule, which applies half-strength guidance at the second step, offers a better balance: it reinforces the prompt switch while leaving the remaining steps to refine the generated content.

The cache-free pass re-noises the previous chunk with a noise sample ϵ \epsilon , so the redrawn chunk, and hence the residual r k r_{k} , depends on ϵ \epsilon .

Tab. 9 shows that sharing improves subject consistency, most clearly on Self Forcing, resulting in slightly higher Quality on both models.

blocks.en:
Unlike chunk-wise models, Rolling Forcing [ 34 ] denoises a window of T = 4 T{=}4 chunks held at staggered noise levels and advances the whole window by one step per forward pass.
With each pass the front chunk leaves the window clean and is written to the KV cache, and a pure-noise chunk enters at the back.
A chunk therefore receives its first prediction when it enters the window, and the step index of Eq. ( 4 ) corresponds to its position from the back.
Residual guidance is mapped onto this schedule as follows.
Before each post-switch chunk k k enters the window, s k − 1 s_{k-1} is taken as the clean chunk that most recently left the window, which is also the last one written to the cache.
It is re-noised to τ = 850 \tau{=}850 and restored once under the new prompt without the cache, which gives r k r_{k} as in Eq. ( 3 ).
The residual is then applied by window position: λ 1 ​ r k \lambda_{1}r_{k} is added to the prediction of chunk k k while it sits at the back of the window and λ 2 ​ r k \lambda_{2}r_{k} at the next position, so that every chunk receives the schedule of the chunk-wise setting exactly once as it passes through the window.
Chunks from the previous prompt that are still in the window at the switch are left unmodified, so the frames before the switch are preserved.
For the first post-switch chunk no chunk has yet left the window under the new prompt, and the prediction of the front chunk, which is the most refined one in the window, is used as s k − 1 s_{k-1} .
Tab. 11 reports the result on T2V-CompBench dynamic attribute.
RG raises Achievement from 0.214 to 0.476 while Quality stays within 0.006 of the base model, and Overall increases from 0.704 to 0.752.
Fig. 16 shows qualitative examples: the base model keeps the initial state after the switch, whereas RG realizes the change within the first chunks (e.g., the frost melts into green grass and the sheet of paper crumples into a ball) while the layout and camera remain continuous.
Note that the switch is realized only after the chunks already in the window at the switch have left it, so the change appears one or two chunks later than in the chunk-wise models.

blocks.en: To test whether the gain persists over long rollouts, we extend 50 InteractiveBench scripts from 60 s to 240 s. Each script keeps its six original prompts and is continued with 18 further prompts written by Qwen3-VL-32B, which keep the setting, characters and visual style, introduce one visible event or state change per prompt, and re-describe the scene in full as in the original benchmark. A video therefore spans 24 prompts of about 10 s and 23 switches. We generate with LongLive, with and without residual guidance, under the configuration of Sec. 5 , and both conditions share the seed of the 60 s run. Following LongLive [ 56 ] , we report CLIP per prompt segment, grouped by minute, together with the VBench quality score.
blocks.zh: 为了检验收益是否持续在长期推出之后,我们将50个互动奔驰脚本从60秒延长至240秒。 每个脚本保留了它的6个原始提示,并由由Qune3-VL-32B所写的再18个提示继续,这些提示保持了设置,字符和视觉风格,每个提示引入了1个可见事件或状态变化,并像原基准一样完整地重新描述场景. 因此,录相带的长度为24个提示,大约为10s和23个开关。 我们用"长生"(LongLive)来生成,有和没有残余的指向,在"5"(sec. 5)的配置下,两个条件共享了"60s跑"的种子. 在LongLive [56]之后,我们报告每个快分的CLIP,按分数分组,连同V Bench质量分数.

blocks.en: Tab. 12 shows that the gain in CLIP holds throughout the video and grows over time, from + 0.56 +0.56 in the first minute to + 1.15 +1.15 in the last. blocks.en:
Several recent works report related forms of history-induced suppression, but approach them primarily through cache or memory design.
LongLive [ 56 ] observes that retaining the KV cache delays or prevents prompt switches, attributes this to residual information from the previous prompt, and introduces KV recaching to address it.
SWIFT [ 47 ] similarly identifies a mismatch between cached video history and updated prompt semantics, and proposes semantic injection and adaptive memory allocation.
Echo-Forcing [ 54 ] identifies interference from outdated scene memories and addresses it through structured scene memories and discrepancy-aware memory decay.
In the related but distinct setting of action-conditioned world modeling, Astra [ 64 ] studies how longer visual histories reduce action responsiveness, refers to this phenomenon as visual inertia , and mitigates it through noise-augmented history memory.

SWIFT [47]同样识别出缓存视频历史与更新的即时语义之间的不匹配,并提出了语义注入和适应性记忆分配.
Echo-Forcing [54] 识别出来自过时场景记忆的干扰,并通过结构化场景记忆和差异感记忆衰变来解决.

blocks.en:
A second line of work examines the denoising steps of autoregressive video diffusion under a fixed prompt.
Bai et al. [ 2 ] find that content and motion are largely established at the first denoising step and attribute this to the historical context.
HiAR [ 65 ] relate the first step of few-step students to motion dynamics and sample diversity.
In-Context Forcing [ 55 ] further shows that Self Forcing attends more strongly to the previous frame than to the current one at the first step, and links this to weakened dynamics.
These studies focus on motion, diversity, or temporal drift rather than prompt-switch responsiveness, and primarily address their findings through student retraining.
blocks.zh:

Bai等 (英语). [2] 发现内容和运动在第一个去名步骤上基本确立,将此归因于历史背景.

In-Context Forcing [55] 进一步显示,Self Forcing在第一步比现在更强烈地关注前一个框架,并将此与被削弱的动态联系起来.
这些研究侧重于运动、多样性或时间漂移,而不是即时抽搐反应,主要通过学生再培训解决其调查结果。

blocks.en:
Our analysis complements both lines.
We isolate how the visual content of the retained context suppresses prompt-induced prediction changes, even after recaching under the new prompt.
We further measure the prompt response at each denoising step and show that the step at which the prompt acts most strongly is also the step at which the context suppresses it most, so that later steps cannot recover the switch.
The suppression is already substantial with a single preceding chunk.
Together, these findings identify where a training-free correction should act, which motivates the design of RG.

Residual guidance differs in the quantity it adds.
The direction r k = x ^ ​ ( ∅ , y new ) − s k − 1 r_{k}=\hat{x}(\varnothing,y_{\text{new}})-s_{k-1} that we use is measured without the context and is therefore not a rescaling of the prompt direction of CFG and MAGI-1, which is measured under the context.
History guidance also evaluates a context-free prediction, but on the current noisy sample and as the point to move away from, which reinforces the context, whereas RG evaluates it on the re-noised previous chunk and moves the prediction toward it.
Its reference is the previous clean chunk rather than the current noisy sample, so it is computed once per chunk instead of at every step. Its magnitude is governed by the noise level τ \tau , while its contribution at each denoising step is controlled by λ i \lambda_{i} , rather than by a CFG scale.
The context-free query is obtained from the student itself, which runs without a cache on the first chunk of every video, so no unconditional branch and no training are needed.

Fig. 17 shows the result for w ∈ { 5 , 7 , 10 } w\in\{5,7,10\} on Self Forcing and LongLive.
At w = 5 w{=}5 the switch is only partially realized, as the metal remains mostly clean and the forest appears only at the edges of the desert.
At w = 7 w{=}7 and w = 10 w{=}10 the prediction is pushed far enough to change, but the same scale amplifies every component of the direction, including the ones unrelated to the switch, and the frames show saturated colors and broken geometry before the new prompt is reached.

Sec. 3 raises the question of whether the context can be weakened in other ways than adding a residual.
We compare alternatives on 100 randomly selected pairs of the T2V-CompBench dynamic attribute set with Self Forcing and LongLive (Fig. 18 ).
All alternatives act on the same chunks as residual guidance (RG), from the switch chunk to the end of the video, at every denoising step unless noted.
Besides Achievement and Quality, we report the scene change across the switch: the DreamSim distance between the frames before and after the switch with the changed object masked out, so a method is penalized for altering the background and not for realizing the prompt.

blocks.en:
Removing the context raises Achievement above that of RG, but at the cost of scene preservation.
When the context is removed at every step, Quality drops and the scene change becomes about two to 3.5 times as large as with RG.
When it is removed only at the first step, Quality is maintained, but the scene change is still about twice that of RG.
Keeping a single chunk, whether the first or the previous one, falls short of RG in both Achievement and Quality, and the previous chunk alone also changes the scene more than RG.
Attention down-weighting is unstable. With b = 1 b=1 Achievement barely moves, with b = 2 b=2 it matches RG on LongLive but breaks the scene on Self Forcing, and the balanced value sits in between and loses Quality.
Doubling the cross-attention and applying CFG each raise Achievement by less than 0.2, and doubling the cross-attention also costs Quality.

当它仅仅在第一步被去除时,质量得到维持,但场景变化仍然大约是RG的两倍.
保持单个块,无论是第一块还是上块,在成就和质量上都低于RG,而之前的块单独改变场景也大于RG.

将交叉注意和适用CFG提高0.2以下的成绩,将交叉注意翻一番也会提高质量。

blocks.en:
Scaling down the erase term lowers Achievement monotonically.
With the text term alone ( γ = 0 \gamma=0 ), Achievement reaches only 0.351 on Self Forcing and 0.525 on LongLive, which recovers about half of the gain of RG over the base model (Tab. 3 ).
The prompt-difference residual (B − - A), which also keeps only a prompt direction, likewise stays well below RG.
A prompt direction alone is therefore insufficient even when measured without the cache, and erasing what the context imposes contributes as much as strengthening the prompt.
A smaller γ \gamma reduces the scene change at equal Quality, and γ = 0.7 \gamma=0.7 comes close to RG in Achievement, but any γ ≠ 1 \gamma\neq 1 introduces an additional hyperparameter and an extra empty-prompt pass.
At γ = 1 \gamma=1 , the empty-prompt terms cancel, so RG requires only one extra pass and no additional weight.

即时偏差残留(B---A)也只保持了即时方向,同样也远远低于RG.
因此,即使在没有缓存的情况下进行计量,光是迅速的方向也是不够的,而且消除上下文所强加的内容与加强快件一样有帮助。

在γ=1\gamma=1时,空出即时名词被取消,因此RG只需要多一个通取而无需多加重量.

blocks.en:
How the reconstruction enters the chunk matters as much as the reconstruction itself.
Outputting the cache-free reconstruction directly or correcting a context-visible one raises Achievement but loses as much Quality as removing the context, and the scene change rises accordingly.
Starting from the reconstruction keeps the scene but barely changes the content, as the cache pulls the chunk back to the previous state.
Pure substitution falls below RG in both Achievement and Quality, while adding the same information as a residual keeps the detail of the context-aware prediction.
RG is thus the simplest variant that raises Achievement substantially while keeping Quality at the level of the base model and the scene change small.

直接输出无缓存重建或纠正可上下文的重建 成就但损失质量与去除上下文一样多,场景也相应提升.
从重建开始保留了场景,但几乎没有改变内容,因为缓存将块拉回了以前的状态.
纯置换在成就和质量上都低于RG,同时添加了与剩余值相同的信息,保持了上下文感知预测的细节.
因此,RG是最简单的变体,它大大提高了成就,同时将质量保持在基模型的水平上,场景变化也很小.

blocks.en:
Fig. 19 shows two switches: on Self Forcing, a bare rocky cliff should become snow-covered, and on LongLive, a green rose and a violet tulip should turn brown and bright orange.
RG adds snow to the same slope, with clouds now covering the ridge, and recolors the same two flowers, while the camera and the layout stay as before the switch.
Without context, whether removed at the first step or at every step, the new prompt is reached, but a different mountain and a different bouquet are drawn.
Direct reconstruction also redraws the scene, and on the flowers it swaps their positions.
The previous chunk alone replaces the mountain with another snowy peak and colors the flowers yellow and magenta.
Doubling the cross-attention and same-chunk correction leave visible artifacts.
Lowering the cache logits by 1 and redraw initialization keep both videos in the old state, and CFG at w = 3 w{=}3 changes only the center of the rose.
Among these variants, RG is the only one that follows the new prompt and largely keeps the scene, which matches the trade-off in Fig. 18 .

blocks.en: F.4 Scene cuts
blocks.zh: F.4 联合国 场景切开

blocks.en:
Some prompts in our benchmarks already involve a scene cut, as in film editing.
For example, in Fig. 12 , spilled water forms a river and a boat then sails on it.
Here, we examine this setting directly with prompts that keep the subject and replace the entire scene.
RG is applied to Infinity-RoPE with RoPE Cut enabled, which is its mechanism designed for scene cuts.
As shown in Fig. 20 , Infinity-RoPE often remains in the previous scene even with RoPE Cut, whereas RG moves to the new scene at each switch while retaining the subject.
Since a scene cut requires a larger change than an in-scene switch, we use a higher noise level of τ = 950 \tau=950 , which we find to replace the scene more reliably than the default τ = 850 \tau=850 .

在这里,我们直接用提示来检查这个设置,以保持主题并取代整个场景.

blocks.en: Fig. 21 shows representative failures of RG, which fall into two types.
blocks.zh: 图21显示了RG的代表性故障,这属于两种类型.

blocks.en:
In the left column, the switch is not realized with or without RG.
The cloud remains in the sky, the room becomes only slightly darker, and the dog does not rest its head on its paws.
These prompts request the removal of an object, a change of global illumination, or a change of fine-grained pose, while the layout of the scene stays the same.
We attribute these failures to the way the residual is obtained.
The previous chunk is re-noised only to an intermediate level, so its coarse structure and overall color survive the reconstruction, and the resulting residual is small for changes of this kind.
In particular, an object that is removed with nothing taking its place belongs to this coarse structure and tends to remain.
A higher noise level strengthens the response but also alters the scene (Sec. 5.3 ).
The third example comes from InteractiveBench, where consecutive prompts share most of their description, which further reduces the difference that the new prompt can induce.

blocks.en:
In the right column, the switch is realized but is accompanied by changes that the prompt does not request.
The ice cream becomes firm scoops, but a spoon and a hand enter the frame.
The juice turns green, but the glass acquires a handle.
The planets appear, but the cup itself turns into a ringed planet.
Since the residual is estimated without the cache, content that the new prompt leaves unspecified is not constrained by the preceding frames in this estimate, and the prior of the model can enter the next chunk through the residual.
This is most visible in the third example, where the new prompt does not mention the cup.

由于剩余部分在没有缓存的情况下进行估计,因此本估计中未指明的新快取出部分的内容不受前述框架的限制,而模型的前期可以通过剩余部分进入下一个块.
这在第三个例子中最为明显,其中新的提示没有提及杯子.

blocks.en:
Together, these examples suggest a remaining trade-off between responsiveness and preservation: a weak correction can miss subtle changes, while an insufficiently selective correction can alter content beyond the prompt.
Future work could explore prompt-aware adaptation of the residual’s strength and spatial extent to better balance these two objectives.
blocks.zh:
这些例子加在一起表明,在反应能力与保全之间仍有取舍:微弱的校正可能错过微妙的变化,而不够有选择性的校正则可能改变内容,超出即时。
今后的工作可以探讨迅速认识到剩余力量和空间范围的调整,以更好地平衡这两个目标。
